messages:
Alice Chen: Heads up — we saw a regression spike this morning in APAC on CUDA 12.2 quant builds when running the long-form QA prompts. Failing requests ~0.6% but affects latency tail. Trying to assemble a quick hotpatch window with partners.
Ben Ortiz: Ack. Can you paste the failing stack? Is this driver/kernel or runtime?
Alice Chen: Stack looks like kernel/driver interaction at nvlink handshake, reproduced on our internal rosetta images on ap-southeast1. Repro steps: run the stress prompt set for ~2k tokens, ~p99 jumps.
Carla Gomez: Oof. Any marketplace images already using the affected driver?
Alice Chen: Yes — marketplace image tag gpu-runtime:2026-03-15-driver-535.86 (internal label) is live in ap-southeast1 and ap-northeast1 small fleets.
Dinesh Rao: Vendor says they pushed a micro-hotfix (driver 535.86.1) but it's not certified on our marketplace. We need partner signoff + image rebuild + smoke canary.
Emma Li: Suggested flow: 1) vendor publishes signed driver artifact; 2) we build marketplace image with pinned driver 535.86.1 and run canary 1% in ap-southeast1 for 90m; 3) if green, promote to 25% for 2h; 4) full rollout. Rollback: revert to 535.86 and force-kill canary instances.
Tom S.: Who owns the canary automation for marketplace images? I can flip lanes but need a runbook to follow — don't want to be awake at 3am without checklist.
Vendor Liaison: Partner (SI) available between 22:00-02:00 SGT for the patching window. They requested we coordinate a single maintenance window and provide signed kernel logs.
Ben Ortiz: Can we shift to a night window that hits both ap-northeast and ap-southeast overlap? Looks like 23:00 SGT / 00:00 JST works.
Carla Gomez: Confirmed — that's within our APAC oncall handoff. I'll book the runway and add the SI contact + vendor ticket.
Dinesh Rao: Quick smoke commands (for canary):
```
# run lightweight load for smoke check
docker run --rm redwood/gpu-runtime:2026-03-15-driver-53586.1 
  /bin/sh -c "python -m rwi.smoke --profile=apac-quant --tokens=2000 --concurrency=4"
# health endpoint check
curl -sSf https://canary.ap-southeast1.redwood.internal/healthz
```
Emma Li: Add perf assertions: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms, error-rate < 0.1% otherwise abort. Also compare sample outputs for determinism on the eval set (prompt-seed-2026-03).
Tom S.: I'll prepare a short one-pager runbook and paste commands in the ops playbook channel. Please include the exact image tag we promote.
Alice Chen: Image tag we'll use if vendor binary is ok: `redwood/marketplace:gpu-2026-03-20-driver-53586-1-apac-canary`
Vendor Liaison: Partner needs signed test artifacts and kernel oops logs. Can you attach after the 1% run? They prefer a single zipped bundle.
Ben Ortiz: I'll capture `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log` and dmesg if we see OOPS and upload to the vendor ticket.
Carla Gomez: Ramp plan: canary 1% (90m) -> 25% (2h) -> 60% (3h) -> full (gradual). Communication: marketplace release note + partner comms + in-console banner for Dedicated customers.
Dinesh Rao: Add automatic rollback triggers in the deployment job: if error-rate > 0.2% for 15m OR p95 regresses by >30% vs baseline, rollback. I'll add CI gates.
Emma Li: We'll also run the regression-eval harness (prompt-suite apac-critical) in parallel to validate output quality; runbook should include how to abort canary and mark rollback reason in JIRA.
Tom S.: I'll be on standby for the first window (23:00 SGT). Who else is on call? @Emma Li, @Dinesh Rao, @Ben Ortiz please confirm.
Ben Ortiz: Confirmed, I'll handle logs and vendor comms during window.
Emma Li: Confirmed.
Dinesh Rao: Confirmed. I'll add vendor escalation numbers.
vendor-bot: Deploy ticket created: #DEPLOY-9876. Canary lane created in ops; scheduled 2026-03-20T15:00Z (23:00 SGT).
Alice Chen: Great — last items: 1) update SLA notes for Dedicated customers in affected regions, 2) pre-stage rollback image so we can revert in <10m, 3) verify KMS signing keys for the driver blob.
Carla Gomez: I'll update SLA notes and pre-stage revert images under tag `redwood/marketplace:gpu-prepatch-2026-03-15-driver-53586`
Ben Ortiz: KMS check: I verified signing key exists and partner's signature verifies against our public key. Good to go.
Vendor Liaison: Partner will run residency tests during the 1% window and will provide signed test output within 30m of canary end.
Alice Chen: Thanks all. I'll post the finalized runbook link in a follow-up message and ping the SI contact 1h before start. :thumbsup:
Tom S.: Thanks — I'll paste the one-pager in #eng-sre and link back here. Good luck everyone.
Carla Gomez: Booking note: maintenance page scheduled for 23:00-02:00 SGT window, includes contact: si-oncall@partner.example.com.
Ben Ortiz: FYI we'll also notify marketplace customers with >= 99.9% SLA that they might see brief p99 blips during canary.
Alice Chen: Thread closed for now — follow-up will have the runbook + final image tag.
